correctness.rationale: An explicit source-accurate two-stage SDIRK21 matrix calculation gives strictly positive first-stage components, all case-wise denominator weights, and a unique positive conservative corrected linear solve. The uncorrected second-stage stability function and its derivative give the global minimum and both sharp interval endpoints. Pointwise epsilon-floor limits include predictor face equalities. The proof calculates a nonzero exact-flow error witness and a finite first boundary-layer coefficient. 9,020 independent deterministic checker assertions corroborate the algebra but do not prove the theorem.

value.rationale: The exact two-state stiffness phase diagram and full-simplex singular-floor map identify when a positivity-preserving and conservative correction can concentrate near a wrong simplex face, even though the physical flow remains in the interior. The sharp threshold, bounded reentrant window, error witness and O(epsilon) scale quantify an algorithm-specific robust-vs-misleading regime; this is a motivated design boundary not implied by positivity or small-step formal order.
